gen-gf-gabarito-gf-sarala: Sarala reads friendly and current, its letters thick like neon glass tubing. Gabarito is best at flaunting one-nib shapes with terminals cut open, while Sarala, a plain sans, is best at staying approachable.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-sawarabi-gothic: Gabarito draws every letter as if with a single nib. Sawarabi Gothic keeps open jaws on every curved stroke, and that shared openness, with Gabarito's terminals cut wide, is what ties the two together.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-shanti: Gabarito gives its round letters walls just as sturdy as the straight ones, with terminals cut open so the counters flow outward. Shanti, a plain sans, carries the text below with a generous e.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-shippori-antique: Terminals cut open so the counters flow outward give Gabarito its distinctive look, drawn as if with a single nib. Shippori Antique's monoweight sans skeleton and open bowls carry that openness onward.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-shippori-antique-b1: Gabarito looks drawn with a single nib, its terminals cut open so counters flow outward. Shippori Antique B1, a sans-serif with daylight through every curve, leaves Gabarito to earn its keep big and short.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-sn-pro: Expressive from the first letter, Gabarito looks drawn with one nib, terminals cut open. And SN Pro, a sans-serif, keeps open aperture curves throughout, so the pair's best quality is that shared openness.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-snippet: Snippet's c gapes like a crescent wrench opened wide, wire-bent across the word. Snippet, a sans, does its best work in text, whereas Gabarito shows off with one-nib shapes and open terminals.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-sour-gummy: Distinctive Gabarito looks bent from one length of tubing. Gabarito is best at being looked at, with open terminals, while Sour Gummy, a sans-serif with wide gaps, keeps tiny sizes crisp.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-source-sans-3: Source Sans 3 has an a whose lower bowl opens to breathe. Gabarito's stroke holds steady pressure like a stylus, and its open terminals share that generosity, which is the pair's best quality.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-spinnaker: Contemporary Spinnaker keeps its counters connected to the space outside. Gabarito, with rounded strokes like cut cord, earns its keep big and short, while Spinnaker, a plain sans, simply stays open.
